FIR COMPLAINT — Cyber Financial Fraud

Date: 15 August 2026
Police Station: Cyber Crime Cell, Bengaluru
Complainant: Rahul Sharma

The complainant states that on 14 August 2026, he received a WhatsApp message from phone number +919876543210.
The sender identified himself as a bank officer and instructed the victim to transfer ₹85,000 to account number 123456789012
(IFSC: HDFC0001234) for KYC verification.

The victim later received another call from +919988776655 asking him to transfer an additional 50 hazaar rupees
to UPI ID fraudster@paytm.

Suspect vehicle KA01AB1234 was seen near MG Road, Bengaluru.
Victim's email: rahul.sharma@gmail.com

The accused persons are believed to be Amit Kumar and Mohan Singh who operate from an office at Koramangala, Bengaluru.
